name: steam_nozzle_exit
title: Steam nozzle exercise
summary: Steady flow of steam through a nozzle. The equation window sets the inlet at 17 bar and 370 °C, area 0.018 m² and mass flow 4.53 kg/s; the steam leaves at 13.8 bar and 274 m/s with a specific heat loss of 1.27 kJ/kg. The model computes the inlet velocity and the exit temperature from the steady-flow energy balance. ULiège MECA0002 exercise, 2022-2023.
